summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its first quarter 2026 earnings results. The report presents unaudited financial highlights including revenues of US$1,447 million (up 31% year-over-year), adjusted EBIT of US$94.0 million, and an all-time high firm order backlog of US$32.1 billion. The filing is a routine periodic earnings disclosure with no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special situation. As a foreign private issuer's standard earnings release, it does not constitute a special-situation event.
